products.notes: minidsp.com blocks automated fetch (Cloudflare); specs from AVNirvana review. 8 in (high-level max 8 or 12 Vrms, low-level 4 or 2 Vrms, jumper) + SPDIF coax/Toslink (ASRC 44.1-192k); 12 RCA out. 10 PEQ per channel; Dirac Live on 8 channels, remaining 4 outputs post-Dirac matrix. Max output 4.5 Vrms per review (Parts Express lists 6 Vrms - conflict). SNR 115 dB, THD+N 0.0007%. 48 kHz processing. Max delay not confirmed.

source.software: miniDSP C-DSP 8x12 DL plugin + Dirac Live

products.notes: Discontinued. Retailer (Audiophonics) copy of spec: 4 analog in (RCA max 2 Vrms; terminal blocks 4 Vrms unbalanced / 8 Vrms balanced) + SPDIF coax; 8 RCA out max 2 Vrms. ADAU1445, 48 kHz internal. Retailer describes '6-band parametric equalizer' (per channel, unconfirmed). Max delay not confirmed. Configured via miniDSP plugin over USB.

miniDSP product brief (hosted by dealer). 2ch analog RCA in (max 2 or 4 Vrms, jumper; 10k), Toslink, USB audio (XMOS, to 192k); 4 RCA out max 2 Vrms (560 ohm). 400 MHz SHARC, 96 kHz internal processing (plugin dependent); PEQ + delay + FIR per output (band count/delay not in brief). THD+N 0.001% USB->RCA. 12 VDC. Not automotive-specific but common in car installs.

Retailer (Audiophonics) copy; minidsp.com blocks fetch. 2-in/4-out (3rd gen 2x4). RCA version: 1 stereo RCA in (100 kohm, max 2 Vrms) + Bluetooth, USB, coax, Toslink; 4 RCA out max 2 Vrms, 200 ohm (Balanced version: 4 Vrms in/out). SHARC ADSP21489; processing 32-bit/96 kHz (48 kHz with Dirac Live licence). 10 PEQ per output (docs.minidsp.com Flex manual, via search snippet), IIR+FIR, delay per output (max not officially confirmed; forum reports 80 ms on Flex Balanced). SNR 115 dB(A) analog-analog / 120 D-A, THD+N -106 dB. 12 V DC.

Specs via search snippets of miniDSP/Audiophonics pages (minidsp.com blocks automated fetch). 8-ch processor: 8 ch from USB/HDMI eARC (LPCM), 2 ch from Toslink/SPDIF (20-216 kHz ASRC); 8 RCA outs, 200 ohm, max 2 Vrms. SHARC ADSP21489, processing 32-bit/48 kHz. Optional multichannel Dirac Live. Analog input count, PEQ count, max delay not confirmed (forum: up to 30 ms).

Retailer copy. Streaming 2-in/4-out processor: analog in RCA (2 Vrms) / XLR (4 Vrms), digital USB, Ethernet, USB host, coax, Toslink, AES/EBU (to 192k); 4 analog outs on XLR (4 Vrms) and RCA (2 Vrms) + 2 S/PDIF out. 10-band parametric EQ (description), 48 dB/oct crossovers, compressor/limiter, Dirac Live. Internal 96 kHz. SNR 120 dB, THD+N 0.0003%. AC mains powered (110-240 V) - home unit, rarely used in cars. Max delay not stated.

Retailer copy. 2 ch RCA in (2/4 Vrms switchable, 10 kohm) + Toslink + USB (XMOS, ASRC); 4 RCA out 2 Vrms. SHARC ADSP21489, 32-bit/48 kHz processing, Dirac Live licence included; crossover/matrix on outputs. PEQ count and max delay not stated. 12 VDC.

Retailer copy (discontinued). 8 analog in (RCA unbalanced + balanced terminals) / 8 analog out (RCA + balanced, both active). 32-bit DSP, 24-bit I/O, 48 kHz internal. Dirac Live licence included; DDRC-88BM plugin adds bass management/crossovers. miniDSP staff (forum): RCA input 2 Vrms max (jumper-adjustable). PEQ count, max delay, SNR not stated. 12 V 3.3 A adapter.

miniDSP product briefs (dealer-hosted). All-digital: SPDIF coax or Toslink in (ASRC to 192k) -> 4 SPDIF coax outs (8 ch); needs external DACs/digital amps. 28/56-bit DSP. 2x8 Xover plug-in: 96 kHz, 5 PEQ per input + 5 PEQ per output (peak/shelf, Q 0.5-50), LR/BW/Bessel up to 48 dB/oct, delay up to 9 ms per output in 0.02 ms steps. Other plug-ins change rate/features. 5-24 VDC.
